description: Convert a Jalali (Solar Hijri, Persian, Shamsi) calendar date to the Gregorian calendar. Use it to turn a date written in the Iranian calendar back into an ISO 8601 date, to check whether a Jalali date is today, or to compare an Iranian deadline with a Western one. Returns the Gregorian year, month, day and weekday. ($0.005 per call, USDC on Base)
name: fa_jalaliToGregorian
